title: Veneers in Miami vs Turkey vs Colombia: the true all-in cost
seoTitle: Veneers Miami vs Turkey vs Colombia: True All-In Cost Compared
description: Packages abroad advertise 20 veneers for $5,300 to $6,800 with a hotel. Add flights, days off, a revision trip and an unreachable warranty, then compare $6,999 in Miami.
author: Dr. Gretell Alonso Fiel, DMD
imageAlt: Airplane window view on descent into Miami at golden hour with a passport on the tray table
answer: Packages in Turkey and Colombia advertise 20 veneers for **$5,300 to $6,800** including a hotel. Add an international round-trip flight, the days away, and a second trip if anything needs adjusting, and the all-in cost is usually at or above **$6,999**, which is what 20 porcelain veneers cost at Xiluet Smiles in Miami, with a 5-year written warranty 15 minutes from the airport. Whoever you choose, ask how much tooth will be removed.

sections.h2: The brochure price and the all-in price are different numbers

blocks.p: The pitch for veneers abroad is simple: a full set, a hotel and airport transfers for less than one arch costs in a US city. For patients in Europe, where Turkey is a short flight, that math can work. For a patient in the United States it rarely does, because the brochure leaves out the parts that cost the most: the flight, the days away, the trip back if something needs fixing, and a warranty you cannot use from home.

This article puts those parts back on the table. The package figures come from prices published by clinics in Turkey and Colombia in October 2026, the Miami figures from our own price list, and we have tried to be fair to all three. If you live in Madrid, read it differently than if you live in Atlanta.

Published packages for 20 porcelain veneers run about [$5,300 in Turkey](https://www.dentavacation.com/dental-veneers-in-turkey/), with ranges up to roughly $7,600 once hotel and transfers are bundled, and [$5,300 to $6,800 in Colombia](https://colombiacaredental.com/veneers-package-colombia/) with a hotel included. Per tooth, that is $200 to $450 in Turkey and $300 to $550 in Colombia. Our package in Miami is $6,999 for 20 veneers, $350 per tooth, with cleaning, X-rays, design preview, temporaries and a 5-year written warranty. Prices shown are minimum fees. Your final fee is confirmed in writing after a doctor's evaluation.

blocks.p: We have left the flight as a description rather than a dollar figure because it depends on your city and your dates. Price it yourself before you compare. The point of the table is that once a transatlantic ticket and a week of your time are added to a $5,300 package, the total is rarely below $6,999, and if anything needs adjusting, the second ticket decides the comparison on its own.

sections.h2: The clinical risk: crowns sold as veneers

blocks.p: Price is the smaller issue. A British Dental Association survey of 1,000 UK dentists found that [86% had treated complications](https://www.bda.org/media-centre/uk-dentists-picking-up-the-pieces-from-dental-tourism-boom/) from dental work done abroad, and 87% of those named crowns. This is where the phrase "Turkey teeth" comes from: teeth ground to pegs for crowns that were sold as veneers.

The difference is not cosmetic. A porcelain veneer covers the front of the tooth and removes about [0.3 to 0.7 mm of enamel](https://acedntl.com/minimal-prep-veneers). A crown wraps the whole tooth and removes [60 to 70 percent of it](https://www.theperfectsmile.co.uk/news/why-you-should-avoid-turkey-teeth-like-the-plague). Enamel matters for how long the work lasts: in a 15-year study of 672 veneers, those bonded to enamel survived [96.7% versus 93.9%](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/jerd.70016) when more dentin was exposed. A crown can be the honest choice for a broken or root-canalled tooth. It is not a veneer, and it should not be priced or described as one.

Why does it happen? A package that promises 20 teeth in a few days, at a price that leaves little room for planning, pushes toward the fastest prep that fits any tooth: a crown. Minimal-prep veneers take more planning, a design you approve first and a ceramist who can work thin. Our veneers are 0.3 mm, with very little, sometimes no, tooth removal, and we confirm that at Visit 1 before anything is touched.

sections.h2: Four costs the package does not show

steps: **Your time.** A package sets the nights it covers. Ask what happens, and what it costs, if the lab needs an extra day. In Miami the week is Monday to Thursday, with Wednesday free, because our lab is in the building.

**The revision trip.** Fracture and debonding, when they happen, cluster in the first two years. Abroad, a repair means another international flight. Here, the doctor who placed your veneers is 15 minutes from MIA.

**Local care afterwards.** Patients report that dentists at home are reluctant to touch work done elsewhere, and a warranty from another country does not help them. Ours states that small adjustments are honored by any dentist, with a video check-in two weeks after delivery.

**Communication.** Shade, length and shape are decided in conversation. If the person preparing your teeth does not share a language with you, that conversation goes through someone else. Our doctors and your coordinator speak English and Spanish.

blocks.p: There is also a simpler cost. A trip to Istanbul or Medellín with a fixed clinic schedule is not a vacation. Most of your days are appointments, numb lips and temporaries.

sections.h2: How Miami can match a package abroad

blocks.p: Our price is possible for the same reason the packages abroad are: the lab is not a separate business. Our ceramist works in the same building as our doctors, so there is no outside lab fee of $200 to $800 per tooth, no shipping, and shade is matched in person. Add an address on SW 8th Street rather than Brickell, and $6,999 for 20 veneers is a shorter supply chain, not a cheaper veneer. The full breakdown is in [how much porcelain veneers cost in Miami](/blog/porcelain-veneers-cost-miami).

Against the Miami market, the same $6,999 sits below every published Miami package we found except one, and the 5-year written warranty is longer than anything else we found here; the longest elsewhere in Miami was one year. See [what the warranty covers](/blog/veneer-warranty-what-it-covers).

blocks.quote: Compare the whole trip, not the brochure. The veneers are the cheapest part of a smile you have to fly back to fix.

sections.h2: How to compare any two quotes, wherever they are from

blocks.p: Use the same seven questions for every clinic, in Miami or abroad. The answers should arrive in writing. If a clinic will not put one of them on paper, that is your answer.

list: How many millimeters of tooth will be removed, and will I see photos of prepared teeth?
Will I see and approve the design in my mouth before any drilling?
Where are the veneers made, and who matches the shade?
What does the price include: cleaning, X-rays, temporaries, lab, design?
How many nights does the package cover, and what does an extra day cost?
What is the warranty, for how long, and how do I claim it from home?
Who adjusts the veneers if something is off after I leave?

blocks.p: Our answers: 0.3 mm with photos, yes before any tooth is touched, in this building, all of it, three nights with a free Wednesday, five years in writing with small adjustments honored by any dentist, and the doctor who placed them. Send three photos through the [free photo evaluation](/free-photo-evaluation) and you have the written estimate within 6 hours. Then book the flight, not before. Details of the week are on the [out-of-state patients page](/out-of-state-patients).

faq.q: Are veneers really cheaper in Turkey or Colombia?
faq.a: The package often is: $5,300 to $6,800 for 20 veneers with a hotel. Add a round-trip international flight, the days away and a second trip if anything needs adjusting, and the all-in total is usually at or above $6,999, which is the Xiluet price in Miami.

Crowns sold as veneers. A crown removes 60 to 70 percent of the tooth; a veneer removes about 0.3 to 0.7 mm of enamel. A British Dental Association survey found 86% of UK dentists had treated complications from work abroad, most often crowns.

faq.q: How do I know I am getting veneers and not crowns?
faq.a: Ask how many millimeters will be removed and to see photos of prepared teeth. Veneer preparation is 0.3 to 0.7 mm on the front surface. If the plan is to reduce the whole tooth, it is a crown.

faq.q: How many days do I need in Miami?
faq.a: Monday to Thursday. Visit 1 Monday, preparation Tuesday, Wednesday free, delivery Thursday with the warranty in writing, and you fly home the same evening.

faq.q: What if something goes wrong after I fly home?
faq.a: Small adjustments are honored by any dentist under the warranty. For a repair, the doctor who placed your veneers books you, 15 minutes from MIA. Abroad, the same problem means another international flight.
